import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyWeilDivisor
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ModulesStalkLengthRestriction
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyLocalLength
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LocalizedPrincipalQuotient
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CartierKernelDivisor
import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.OrdCompare

/-!
# Cartier quotient stalks and local orders

The stalk of an actual Cartier quotient is the local ring modulo the germ
of its equation.  Consequently its intrinsic length equals the order of that
germ.  This is an AJC-native curve bridge from Kleiman's invertible ideals
(`sb:ediv`) to the Weil-divisor coefficients used in the Grassmannian route.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierKernel

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} {E F : X.Modules}

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The local length of a Cartier quotient equals the order of the equation
germ, computed from any affine neighbourhood inside a trivializing chart. -/
theorem stalkLength_eq_ord (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (eO : E ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (eI : kernel q ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (z : U) :
    Modules.stalkLength F z = Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk z)
      (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ z trivial (localEquation q eO eI)) := by
  letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk z)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf z) : Type u) :=
    Modules.presheafStalkModule F.val z
  letI : Module Γ(X, U)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf z) : Type u) :=
    Module.compHom _ (X.presheaf.germ U z z.2).hom
  letI : Algebra Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk z) :=
    X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk z
  letI : IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) (X.presheaf.stalk z)
      (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F.val.presheaf z) : Type u) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_smul (fun _ _ => rfl)
  haveI := hU.isLocalization_stalk z
  haveI := Modules.isLocalizedModule_moduleGermLinearMap F hU z
  let e := quotientSectionsEquiv q eO eI U hU
  let f := (Modules.presheafGermLinearMap F.val z).comp e.toLinearMap
  haveI : IsLocalizedModule (hU.primeIdealOf z).asIdeal.primeCompl f :=
    IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv_right _ _ e
  have h := IsLocalizedModule.length_eq_ord
    (S := X.presheaf.stalk z) (hU.primeIdealOf z).asIdeal.primeCompl
    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
      (localEquation q eO eI)) f
  change Modules.stalkLength F z = _ at h
  refine h.trans ?_
  congr 1
  exact X.presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- On a smooth curve, the classical order of a Cartier equation is the
finite length of the actual quotient stalk. -/
theorem ordZ_localEquationUnit_eq_stalkLength
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 p] [IsIntegral X]
    (q : E ⟶ F) [Epi q] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (eO : E ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (eI : kernel q ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    {z : X} (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (ordZ p hz (localEquationUnit q eO eI)) =
      ((Modules.stalkLength F z).toNat : ℤ) := by
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian p
  letI := isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk p hz
  letI := isDedekindDomain_stalk p hz
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hzU, -⟩ :=
    exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := z) (U := ⊤) trivial
  have hlen := stalkLength_eq_ord q eO eI U hU ⟨z, hzU⟩
  have ha : X.presheaf.germ ⊤ z trivial (localEquation q eO eI) ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha
    apply localEquation_ne_zero q eO eI
    apply germ_injective_of_isIntegral X (U := ⊤) z trivial
    exact ha.trans (map_zero _).symm
  have hreg := mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
  have hfinite : Modules.stalkLength F z ≠ ⊤ :=
    hlen.trans_ne (Ring.ord_ne_top hreg)
  rw [ordZ_toAdd_eq_log_ordFrac p]
  change WithZero.log (Ring.ordFrac (X.presheaf.stalk z)
    (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) trivial (localEquation q eO eI))) = _
  rw [germ_generic_eq_algebraMap_germ (X := X) (x := z) (U := ⊤) trivial trivial,
    Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord (X.presheaf.stalk z) ha,
    Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_coe (X.presheaf.stalk z) hreg
      (hlen.symm.trans (ENat.coe_toNat hfinite).symm)]
  rfl

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CartierKernel

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S}

local instance : IsIntegral (pullback π s) := fieldTest_isIntegral (π := π) (s := s)

local instance : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (pullback.snd π s) :=
  fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)

local instance (U : (pullback π s).Opens) :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (U.ι ≫ pullback.snd π s) :=
  IsZariskiLocalAtSource.comp (fieldTest_smooth (π := π) (s := s)) U.ι

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The globally constructed Weil coefficient equals the classical order of
every local Cartier equation.  The kernel trivialization is only on the chart. -/
theorem effectiveWeilDivisor_apply_eq_chart_order
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk s))
    (U : (pullback π s).Opens) [Nonempty U]
    (e : kernel (chartQuotient x U) ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (U : Scheme).ringCatSheaf)
    (z : U) (hz : z.val ≠ genericPoint (pullback π s : Scheme)) :
    toFinsupp x.effectiveWeilDivisor ⟨z.val, hz⟩ =
      Multiplicative.toAdd (ordZ (U.ι ≫ pullback.snd π s)
        (show z ≠ genericPoint (U : Scheme) from by
          intro h
          apply hz
          exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).trans (genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι))
        (CartierKernel.localEquationUnit (chartQuotient x U) (Iso.refl _) e)) := by
  letI : x.F.IsFinitePresentation := x.isFinitePresentation
  letI : ((Modules.pullback U.ι).obj x.F).IsFinitePresentation :=
    Modules.pullback_isFinitePresentation U.ι x.F inferInstance
  letI : Epi (chartQuotient x U) := chartQuotient_epi x U
  rw [CartierKernel.ordZ_localEquationUnit_eq_stalkLength]
  change (x.stalkMultiplicity z.val : ℤ) = _
  congr 1
  have heq : Modules.stalkLength ((Modules.pullback U.ι).obj x.F) z =
      Modules.stalkLength x.F z.val :=
    (Modules.stalkLength_eq_of_iso
      ((Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).app x.F).symm z).trans
        (Modules.stalkLength_restrict x.F U z)
  have hfinite : Modules.stalkLength ((Modules.pullback U.ι).obj x.F) z ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [heq, ← coe_stalkMultiplicity]
    exact ENat.coe_ne_top _
  apply ENat.coe_inj.mp
  rw [coe_stalkMultiplicity, ENat.coe_toNat hfinite]
  exact heq.symm

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily
